title: Causal plastic LLM-function network with frozen-agent transfer
owner_question: Can role-specific LLM functions, outcome-bound numeric Semantic Weight Map plasticity, and learned topology cause sealed unseen improvement and donor-specific transfer beyond equal-information text/vector baselines?

canon_preserved.hswm_identity: LLM-executed functions plus hypergraph H plus Semantic Weight Map W plus recurrent plastic state
canon_preserved.learning_target: versioned external numeric W and H
not_claimed: universal superiority over flat or vector systems

testbed.required_extension: two donor-exclusive latent procedural invariants plus common strata and composition-disjoint entity surfaces
testbed.disjointness_identity: world content SHA-256 and entity/relation-program composition
testbed.sample_size_rule: paired pilot variance must show power at least 0.80 for a 0.05 absolute effect; otherwise increase sealed clusters before machine lock

adoption_gate.on_failure: do not seal; retune world difficulty without observing sealed items

BF_BOND_PROPOSER.local_metric: evidence utility on a gold-blind support split

function_contract.port_rule: minimal canonical JSON sufficient statistic only
function_contract.strong_flat_information: union of all raw observations available across typed roles
fairness: same useful input plus output token envelope
no null-call or inert-padding credit toward useful compute

plasticity_contract.fast_weight_update: theta_fast[e] <- clip(theta_fast[e] + eta_W * delta * eligibility[e] - lambda_W * theta_fast[e])
plasticity_contract.topology_update: alpha[e] <- alpha[e] + eta_H * delta * eligibility[e] * (sampled_gate[e] - sigmoid(alpha[e])) - sparsity_penalty - homeostasis_penalty
plasticity_contract.topology_estimator: logged-propensity score-function estimator; no end-to-end gradient claim

kill: learned typed equals prompt-only typed within ROPE plus or minus 0.02
QF or BF interchange preserves the full typed margin
typed wins only when flat or vector receives less information
typed is Pareto-dominated at all useful-token budgets

topology_subclaim.inside_rope: kill topology subclaim while allowing numeric W learning to survive

void: training answer or verdict text appears in a later prompt
model, candidate, information, useful-token, or active-byte parity failure

phase_C_two_donor_transfer.receiver: byte-frozen model, prompt library, code, candidate schema, and initial W/H

metrics.G_match: matched minus max(B_self, mismatched, source_shuffled, placebo)
metrics.DSI: (matched minus mismatched on donor-exclusive strata) minus (matched minus mismatched on common strata)

interpretation.G_match_and_DSI_positive: donor-specific numeric external-state transfer supported narrow

verdict_levels.L1_NEURAL_PLASTIC_NETWORK_SUPPORTED_NARR: phase A plus credit plus numeric W gates pass
verdict_levels.L2_SHARED_HSWM_TRANSFER_SUPPORTED_NARROW: L1 plus phase C G_match and DSI pass
verdict_levels.REJECT_OR_NARROW: report each failed seam independently; no averaged compensation

sleep_consolidation.unlock_condition: L1 and L2 pass with real numeric packets and provenance
sleep_consolidation.reason: F5 age-downscale was rejected; predictive replay requires a working plastic state first
